name: Domain Availability Check
author: hearth-team
description: Check whether domain names are registered, using the public RDAP protocol (rdap.org). No API key. Args: domains (required — one domain, an array, or a comma/space separated string; up to 20; e.g. 'example.com foobar123.io'). For each domain returns available|taken|unknown; taken domains include the registrar and expiry date when the registry publishes them. Note: 'available' means unregistered per RDAP — it is not a purchase quote and premium/reserved names may still be unbuyable.
